shared_elements: human head/face with rendered eyes and mouth
headdress or elaborate hair on a head
justification: Both depict anthropomorphic subjects with a face and an elaborate headcovering — A a three-dimensional head with a tiered/curled cap-like coiffure, B small profile figures in tall headgear within a scene. Beyond the generic 'human with headdress', they share nothing: A is a single frontal head in the round with no scene, whereas B is a low-relief multi-figure composition of standing profile figures facing one another with objects and altar-like elements between them, arranged on an arched panel.
